__hintAgentField: The persona that drives this bot's replies.
__hintAgentName: A label for you to recognize this agent. Users on LINE never see it.
__hintChannelAccessToken: Find this in your LINE channel's "Messaging API" tab.
__hintChannelSecret: Find this in your LINE channel's "Basic settings" tab.
__hintEnabledBot: When off, the bot won't reply.
__hintGithubPatHelp: Create a fine-grained PAT at {link}. Pick the repos and grant read access.
__hintOpenrouterSignup: New to OpenRouter? Free signup, takes a minute.
__hintPlatform: Which messaging service this bot connects to.
__hintScanToAddBot: Scan to add bot on LINE
__hintSystemPrompt: The persona instructions the agent follows. Sets its voice and behavior.
__hintTavilyHelp: Grab a key at {link}. 30 seconds, free, no credit card.
__hintTextModel: The AI model that generates this agent's replies.
__hintTtsModel: The OpenAI TTS engine. gpt-4o-mini-tts is cheaper, higher quality, and the only one that honors voice instructions.
__hintTtsVoice: The character the agent speaks in. Hit play on any voice to hear a short sample.
__hintTtsVoiceInstructionsSupported: Optional tone / pace / accent direction (e.g. 'speak calmly and warmly').
__hintTtsVoiceInstructionsUnsupported: Only honored when voice model is gpt-4o-mini-tts.
__hintTwinkleHubHelp: Sign in at {link} with Google or GitHub, then copy your token from the dashboard.
__hintUnsupportedFormat: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF only.
__hintVisionModel: Used to read images sent into the conversation, whatever the text model is set to. Only vision-capable models are listed.
__hintVoiceReply: Whether the agent speaks its replies. Audio replies use the owner's OpenAI key for TTS and cost more than text.
__hintVoiceReplyAlwaysDescription: Always speak, regardless of how the user wrote.
__hintVoiceReplyAutoDescription: Mirror the user — speak only when the user sent voice.
__hintVoiceReplyOffDescription: Never speak. Always reply with text.
